definitions.s: current canonical state_units after unit propagation fixed point
definitions.T: maximum cooccurrence frequency of any nondegenerate sign-aware literal pair

lemma.statement: Every live pivot x has A_plus_x<=B and A_minus_x<=B. At a unit-propagation fixed point the positive/negative bucket counts p,q satisfy p<=A_plus_x and q<=A_minus_x. The Davis-Putnam raw multiset bound therefore satisfies R_x<=s+3B^2-6B = s+12(n-1)^2*T^2-12(n-1)T. Hence if this quantity is <=N^2, every live pivot fits the frozen monotone N^2 raw cap.
proof: Fix literal +x. For each other underlying variable y there are only two partner signs, +y and -y, hence at most 2(n-1) sign-aware pair types touching +x. Each occurs at most T times, so A_plus_x<=2(n-1)T=B. The same holds for -x.
No unit clause remains. Every clause in the +x bucket contributes at least one nonpivot pair incidence, so p<=A_plus_x; similarly q<=A_minus_x.
The exact raw-multiset delta derived in v1 is D=pq+(q-1)A_plus_x+(p-1)A_minus_x-2(p+q).
If p=0 or q=0 the pivot cannot create a cross-product overflow. Otherwise p,q>=1 and the delta is nondecreasing in p and q because q+A_minus_x-2>=0 and p+A_plus_x-2>=0.
Thus for fixed A_plus_x,A_minus_x the maximum occurs at p=A_plus_x and q=A_minus_x, giving D<=3*A_plus_x*A_minus_x-3(A_plus_x+A_minus_x).
For A_plus_x,A_minus_x>=1 this is nondecreasing in each argument, so the maximum under both <=B is 3B^2-6B.
The implementation discards tautological and duplicate resolvents during raw-set construction, so its monotone raw_units never exceed the multiset bound.

strengthened_corridor.selection: The frozen canonical first_capped_elimination therefore returns a move without heuristic choice.

derived_live_variable_floor.statement: For T>0, any state not covered by the strengthened raw corridor must satisfy (n-1)^2 > (N^2-s+12(n-1)T)/(12T^2); the simpler weaker necessary condition n>1+sqrt(max(0,N^2-s)/(12T^2)) follows by dropping the positive correction term.
derived_live_variable_floor.role: Necessary geometry of a possible gap witness, not a totality theorem.

next_exact_target: Target only the strengthened balanced-pressure wedge in reachable trajectories; do not spend theorem effort on states already certified by low-volume, raw-dispersion, or frequent-pair corridors.
